- Initial release of the domestic-flight skill for real-time domestic flight search in China.
- Zero setup: works out of the box using Fliggy flight data.
- Supports both structured (origin/destination/date) and natural language flight queries.
- Allows filtering by direct or connecting flights, and sorting by price, duration, or departure time.
- Includes seat class selection (economy, business, first class).
- Cloud proxy integration; no user data is stored.
